Complete Timeline Collapse 8 🏆 End of the Game 🎴 TIME SPLICERS — How to Play 🕒 Objective Your goal is to collect 7 Time Crystals before your opponents. Time Crystals are earned by causing Timeline Collapses . 🧩 Setup Each player receives: 1 Meeple 2 Time Jump tokens 2 Time Freeze markers Each player draws 4 cards . Reveal one card to create the first Timeline . Place all meeples on this starting card. 🔄 Turn Structure On your turn, you must perform ONE main action : 1️⃣ Move to an Adjacent Card Move your meeple: to an adjacent card in the same Timeline; OR to a card with the same number in a different Timeline. ➡️ Then draw 1 card. 2️⃣ Use the Time Portal The Time Portal allows you to teleport anywhere. First Turn: Move to the Time Portal. Draw 2 cards. Next Turn: Move from the Portal to any card in play. OR place a card and move onto it. 3️⃣ Place a Card and Move Onto It You may place either: ➤ An Adjacent Card The card must: be the same Timeline color; follow the Timeline’s numerical order. Cards may be shifted to make room for an inserted value. ➤ A Parallel Card You may create a new Timeline using: a different color; but the same number (Era). ⏳ Fixed Points in Time Whenever there are: 3 cards of the same Era → gain 1 Time Jump token. 4 cards of the same Era → gain another Time Jump token. ✋ Hand Limits Minimum Hand Size: 4 Cards At the end of your turn: if you have fewer than 4 cards, draw until you have 4. Maximum Hand Size: 7 Cards If you ever exceed 7 cards: Discard your entire hand. Lose 1 Time Jump token. Draw 4 new cards. ⚠️ If you cannot pay the penalty: you are eliminated from the game. ✨ Special Cards Special cards may be played at the beginning of your turn as a free action. 🌀 Quantum Tunnel Move to any card in play before taking your normal action. ⚡ Time Jump Move to any other card within the same Timeline. A Time Jump token may also be used to: discard your hand; draw 4 new cards. ❄️ Time Freeze Place this card at the end of a Timeline before leaving it to prevent that Timeline from collapsing when empty. When you return to that Timeline: discard your Time Freeze card; recover your marker. ⚠️ Time Freeze does NOT prevent: Partial Timeline Collapses; Complete Timeline Collapses. 💎 Earning Time Crystals 🧨 1. Empty Timeline Collapse When you leave a Timeline: with no other players remaining; and no Time Freeze card protecting it, the Timeline collapses. ➡️ If it contained at least 3 cards: gain 1 Time Crystal. 🔻 2. Partial Timeline Collapse When you create a sequence of 3 consecutive cards: 1-2-3 4-5-6 etc. ➡️ The sequence is discarded. Meeples on those cards move to the nearest remaining card on the left. ➡️ Gain 1 Time Crystal. ☢️ 3. Complete Timeline Collapse If a Timeline containing a Singularity (13) reaches 5 cards: ➡️ The entire Timeline is discarded.
